title: Baseline bounded by the zero extension
statement: Let $\mathcal P$ be a nonempty finite family of sign predicates, and choose $P\in\mathcal P$. The minimum, over $Q\in\mathcal P$, of the empty-set Fourier coefficient of its acceptance indicator is at most the multilinear extension of $P$ at the zero vector.
hypotheses_covered: A member of the family is chosen
